name: Palau
about: Dry season Nov–Apr has the calmest seas and best visibility for diving; wet season (May–Oct) brings more rain and rougher water, though diving continues nearly year-round.
overview: Blue Corner, Jellyfish Lake, and the Rock Islands — among the best diving on Earth, protected by eco-conscious tourism policy.
costOverview: Palau is remote and genuinely expensive to reach, and diving here — the whole reason most people come — is priced accordingly.
monthlyWeather: dry and warm, calm seas with excellent dive visibility
